scope: Exact raw counters and timings from the actual installed ZIP production-default workload; no diagnostic drawing override. These facts do not independently establish release acceptance or a fresh native rerun.

sampledMemory.scope: 50ms self-task samples, not kernel lifetime peaks; phases label observations without proving allocation ownership

entryPoints.initialOpen: AppDelegate.openEditor with production CGImage.read and encoded backing admission
entryPoints.nativeGestures: owned canvas mouseDown/mouseDragged/mouseUp and Command-Z / Space responder events

resourcePolicy.retirement: ordinary history/pin retention replacement, native close, group hide/show, final coordinator termination

replayLimit: Original remote canonical-path existence is established by native CI; portable replay maps only verified archive and actual ZIP plist bytes. All raw common checks replayed; ZIP binary/plist/build-info independently matched.
